title: Greer's iPhone hacked and threats

tellings.quote: In fact, I just had that happen last week. My iPhone was hacked into and all kinds of stuff. I was threatened.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that only the week before, his iPhone had been hacked and he had been threatened. He tells it as part of a pattern of pressure that he says goes back years, which, if true, would suggest someone wants him to stop talking.
